_comment: Paste your mint (CA) after launch. fees_donated is what YOUR coin has routed to charity - take it from pump.fun's creator fee dashboard and update it as it grows. Never quote the charity's own page total as yours.
tagline: forty years on this rock. the light goes on at dusk.
promises: 2 SOL, bought at launch on the same curve as everyone else, from B1bsL7JW52CicRwZdkLvsd7G8fvZtB18QjcpzNPZDUSY. Nothing sold from it for the first 72 hours — nothing before 18 September. That is a floor, not a plan: it is a promise not to sell before then, not a promise to sell after.

One operations wallet, 1 SOL — FCHZSWkhqVUuFughPwataoxGsKr19kW8vuzssNDjapAG. This is the marketing budget. It covers the DexScreener listing, boosts, and the giveaway run before launch — those payouts are visible in the wallet history. That money is a cost, not profit. Disclosed two days before launch.
Two wallets, that's all of them. If a third turns up, it isn't me.
